function.name: check_eligibility
function.description:
Look up whether a member is currently covered and on which plan.

    Returns plan name, active flag, effective/termination dates, PCP, and deductible progress.

function.name: list_claims
function.description: List all claims for a member with status, amounts, and denial code if denied.

function.name: get_claim
function.description: Get one claim by claim ID, including the plain-English meaning of any denial code.

function.name: get_prior_auths
function.description: List prior authorization requests for a member with status, dates, and reviewer notes.

function.name: search_plan_document
function.description:
Search the plan's benefits document. Use for coverage rules, limits, appeals, and network
    questions. Returns the most relevant sections.

function.name: find_providers
function.description:
Find providers by specialty (cardiology, dermatology, orthopedics, physical therapy,
    endocrinology), optionally filtered by ZIP code and network status.

function.name: update_contact_info
function.description: Update a member's mailing address and/or phone number on file.

function.name: file_appeal
function.description: File a first-level appeal on a denied claim. The reason is sent to the appeals team.
